pub enum Decision {
    Disagrees,
    Unreadable,
}

pub struct Verdict {
    pub decision: Decision,
    pub message: String,
}

fn disagrees(message: String) -> Verdict {
    Verdict { decision: Decision::Disagrees, message }
}

fn unreadable(message: String) -> Verdict {
    Verdict { decision: Decision::Unreadable, message }
}
